prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A hand grasping a small stone, seen in profile silhouette, reduced to
essential curves.
formatted_prompt: Flat modern app icon centered on an off-white (#E7E3D5) canvas with generous padding, bold vector geometry, crisp edges readable at 16px. A single adult human hand in profile silhouette, fingers curled in a firm grasp around a small rounded stone, rendered as two interlocking flat shapes — the hand in deep burnt sienna (#D97742) and the stone as a slightly lighter warm tan (#C9A96B). Interior finger-curve detail rendered as one flat secondary-color shape in dark charcoal (#0B0F14), not as linework. Essential silhouette only, no scene, no background elements, no gradients, no texture, no brushwork. Clean sharp vector iconography, 2026-era app design register.
